svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: what shipped lately? Here's the latest public work: Oct 1 aeronautics_deliver… chore: update mod authors in gradle properties Oct 1 TheSandemon refactor(profile): remove Technomads mentions from profile visuals and agent chat Oct 1 TheSandemon docs(profile): update sand.gallery links to kyletouchet.dev Sep 25 TheSandemon Grow the agent chat from Sand's resume Sep 25 TheSandemon Replace the lab with an endlessly typing agent chat Sep 24 TheSandemon Fold the harness panels into one rotating agent chat 25 commits on 12 different days in the recent log. Q: what's in Sand's stack? languages TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, SQL, Bash, C++ frontend React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js backend…
